name: Marcos Degli
event: UFC Fight Night: Bonfim vs. Brady
summary: A 26-year-old Brazilian flyweight (15-3) from Vale Top Team, where he trains with Carlos Prates. Former LFA flyweight champion, on a 13-fight win streak with 14 of 15 wins by finish. He earned a contract on the Contender Series in September with a one-arm rear-naked choke of Paris Moran. UFC debut.

how_they_fight.Striking: Muay Thai base; calls himself an aggressive finisher with 'very heavy hands' (MMA Sucka). Nine KO/TKO wins, six of them in R1. No footage-based breakdown of his striking is available in what we've read.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Underrated, going by the Contender Series win. UFC.com says he pushed Moran to the fence, took him down, nearly finished a standing guillotine, then took the back with a body triangle in R1; in R2 he took Moran down again, tried a face crank and switched to a one-arm RNC at 4:46. Five career submissions.
how_they_fight.Defense: Little information. Moran landed knees to his hamstrings early in R2 (UFC.com). His three losses all came in 2021-22, when he started 2-3: two decisions and an R3 submission.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Early finisher: eight stoppages in R1, five in R2, one in R3 (an LFA TKO in 2025). Only one decision win. Went 15 minutes once in a win (LFA, 2023) and won an LFA main event by R3 TKO (2025).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Adjusts when a submission doesn't land (face crank to one-arm choke). Debuting against a UFC veteran who has never been knocked out.

patterns: Finishes fast: 13 of 14 stoppages in R1-R2
Muay Thai power plus a back-take and choke game
13-fight win streak; regional and LFA opposition
concerns: UFC debut against a durable, mobile veteran
No information yet on how he handles adversity at this level
keys_to_beat: Survive the first round and drag him to the cards
Use movement and takedown defense to deny the back

news.text: Earned a UFC contract with a standing one-arm rear-naked choke of Paris Moran (4:46 R2) on the Contender Series.
Had nearly fought Marwan Rahiki in Australia earlier in 2026, but a visa problem stopped it (Cageside).
Booked against Mitch Raposo for his UFC debut.
